html:
G'oya

"Bir vaqtda" bu kun va dars raqami birga. Xona band bo'lmasligi UNIQUE (room, day, slot), o'qituvchi band bo'lmasligi UNIQUE (teacher, day, slot). Bitta jadvalda bir nechta UNIQUE bo'lishi mumkin, har biri o'z qoidasini qo'riqlaydi.

Yechim

CREATE TABLE timetable (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  room TEXT NOT NULL,
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  slot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (slot BETWEEN 1 AND 6),
  teacher TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (room, day, slot),
  UNIQUE (teacher, day, slot)
)

Namunada 3-dars 101-xonani band qiladi (u yerda dushanba 1-darsda Karimova bor), 4-dars Karimovani ikkinchi xonaga qo'ymoqchi. 5-dars o'tadi: 204-xona ham, Nazarov ham o'sha vaqtda bo'sh.

Tuzoqlar

To'rtta ustunni bitta UNIQUE ga yig'ish ikki qoidani zaiflashtiradi. UNIQUE (room, day, slot, teacher) faqat aynan bir xil to'rtlikni taqiqlaydi: 101-xonaga bir vaqtda ikki xil o'qituvchi bemalol tushadi.

Noto'g'riCREATE TABLE timetable (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  room TEXT NOT NULL,
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  slot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (slot BETWEEN 1 AND 6),
  teacher TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (room, day, slot, teacher)
)

Kunni unutish teskari xato: UNIQUE (room, slot) dushanba 1-darsdan keyin 101-xonani butun hafta 1-darsda yopib qo'yadi. BETWEEN ikki chetini ham o'z ichiga oladi, 1 va 6 ruxsat etilgan.
